name: project-guardrails
description: Per-project guardrails via a user-level plugin. Zero-config by default: if the repo has a handoff ledger carrier, SessionStart automatically injects the ledger index + doc-size budget (convention over configuration). Declare `context`, tool rules and `entrypoints` in <repo>/.agents/guardrails.json (fallback .zcode/) to override or to turn it off (`"entrypoints": []`).
